title: Putting a Temporary Credit on a Personal Checking Account While a Claim Is Open
content:
Where a claim on card, cash machine, direct debit or person-to-person items is still being looked into once the credit has fallen due, the bank puts a temporary credit onto the Personal Checking account so that the owner is not left out of pocket while the work goes on.

A claim that has already been decided is outside this rule and receives no temporary credit.

The account's posted ledger balance rises by the credited amount at once, the owner can use the money while the claim is worked, and the disputed debit itself stays on the record unchanged. The claim moves to the state of standing temporarily credited.

## Recording the credit

The credit is booked with the tool `post_dispute_provisional_credit_b16208c2`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. One call books a single temporary credit entry credited to the named checking account, tied to the claim and to the disputed debit.

### Parameters

- `checking_account_id` — the reference number of the Personal Checking account the temporary credit is posted to, taken from the checking account lookup for this owner. Reference number.
- `customer_id` — the reference number of the customer profile that owns the account and filed the claim, as returned by the customer profile lookup. Reference number.
- `checking_dispute_id` — the reference number of the electronic-transaction claim the temporary credit belongs to, read from the dispute lookup. Reference number.
- `source_item_id` — the reference number of the disputed debit entry on the account that the claim was raised about, read from the account's posted activity. Reference number.
- `credit_amount` — the money credited for the time being, in United States dollars to 2 decimal places, always positive and rounded half-up to the cent at the moment of the call; there is no empty value and zero is not accepted. Fixed format.
- `statement_cycle` — the statement cycle the temporary credit entry belongs to, written as the year and month in which that cycle closes, with no day part and no time zone. Fixed format.

### Return

The call answers with a confirmation sentence carrying the reference number minted for the new temporary credit entry, the credited amount to the cent, the account's posted ledger balance after the credit and the claim's state afterwards. That sentence naming a temporary credit entry reference number is what shows the call completed; the credit is then visible in the account's posted activity.
